parts.label: nuclear-force
parts.display_text: Two protons are initially separated by a nuclear distance. Describe how the attractive nuclear force changes when they are moved far outside the nucleus.

answer.text: The nuclear force has a very short range, of order a few femtometres. Its attraction becomes negligible at separations much larger than nuclear dimensions.

parts.label: electric-force
parts.display_text: Two protons are moved farther apart. Describe how their electrostatic force changes with separation r.

answer.text: It remains repulsive, with magnitude F = ke²/r². Increasing separation by a factor n reduces its magnitude by n².
